name: IndusInd Bank Limited
summary: IndusInd Bank Limited provides various banking products and financial services to individuals, corporations, government entities, and public sector undertakings in India. It operates in four segments: Treasury, Corporate/Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, and Other Banking Operations. The company offers savings, salary, current, and uniformed personnel accounts; fixed, recurring, auto sweep, senior citizen fixed, and term deposits; vehicle, used and new car, two wheeler, home, gold, agri, personal, medical equipment, term, business, and MSME loans; loans against property and securities; loans on credit card; and working capital, supply chain, and trade finance.
